G.1.name: JamCrypto.Bandersnatch.Thin.verify
G.1.note: the model takes this as the parameter field `bsVerify` of `JAM.Crypto`; JamCrypto implements it (v0.8.1 Thin VRF; reading `rd`, default `.prose`)

G.2.name: JamCrypto.Bandersnatch.Thin.vrfOutput
G.2.note: the model takes this as the parameter field `bsOut` of `JAM.Crypto`; JamCrypto implements it

G.3.name: JamCrypto.Ring.root
G.3.note: the model takes this as the parameter field `bsRingRoot` of `JAM.Crypto`; `JamCrypto.Ring.crypto` instantiates it with `gp := .v081` (the default is v0.8.0); the domain 2048 and the Draft-35 reading `rd` are JamCrypto's reading of the cited VRF spec, to be confirmed by v0.8.1 vectors

G.4.name: JamCrypto.Ring.verify081
G.4.note: the model takes this as the parameter field `bsRingVerify` of `JAM.Crypto`; JamCrypto implements it (reading `rd`, default `.prose`)

G.5.name: JamCrypto.Ring.output081
G.5.note: the model takes this as the parameter field `bsRingOut` of `JAM.Crypto`; JamCrypto implements it
